result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): B gives a strong, concrete booking flow: real wheel slots with Book buttons, credits, a pottery-specific getting-started checklist and studio details. It does have several competing elements and a fairly busy sidebar. A is clean and focused, but it stops after a two-option choice with no times, no preview of what happens next and a large empty lower half, so it looks unfinished. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A gives a new member a full first screen. Booking a first wheel session is clearly the main action: real time slots, credit-priced Book buttons and pottery-specific wording like the safety intro and kiln shelf. It does crowd the page a bit with a checklist and studio info, and nothing previews what a booked slot will look like. B is focused and calm, but it shows only a two-option chooser above a large empty area that looks unfinished, and it gives no preview of what happens after booking.
